text: こんな　ときは　しょくぶつ　タイプで　みずを　すいとる　さくせんだ　…　それか　でんき　タイプで　しびれ　させるのも　いいぜ

structure.jp: しょくぶつ　タイプで　みずを　すいとる　さくせんだ
structure.en: the strategy is to soak up the water with Grass types

structure.jp: でんき　タイプで　しびれ　させるのも
structure.en: paralyzing them with Electric types too

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる means to make someone or something do it or get that way. しびれ　させる = 'make them go numb', that is, paralyze them.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.span: しびれ　させるのも　いいぜ
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. With もいい it means 'doing that is good too'. しびれ　させるのも　いい = 'paralyzing them is good too'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, confident male speech, pushing your point at the listener. いいぜ = 'it's good, you know'.
